args.body: Take the open CATALOGUE-QUALIFIED-INQUIRY-ORDER-HANDOFF mission under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent committed handoff. Otherwise use docs/INTERAC-COMMANDES.md and the committed catalogue draft, brief-decision evidence and rehearsal to write one copy-ready EN/FR scope confirmation and one operator checklist. Verify that explicit approval supports keeping B-02 at 25.00 and that missing approval leaves a decision pending unless the supplied brief separately establishes 20.00 as the required value. State the exact customer inputs and keep, correct and resolve-manually outputs. Carry over no welfare price or terms. Leave quote, buyer assent and order reference pending actual case evidence. Identify the separate evidence for a qualified inquiry, administrative order acceptance, delivery and founder-confirmed Treasury posting. Save and read back the artifacts before closing with a lesson. This work can proceed during independent review. Use no private case data, external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

description: Prioritize converting a qualified catalogue inquiry into an operator-ready order. The offline rehearsal confirmed that explicit buyer approval changes B-02 from restore to keep while the checker findings stay fixed. That supports a concrete service deliverable and lets order preparation proceed independently of the public revision, which still requires host-enforced independent approval of its exact digest. Aggregate feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The order register is unavailable in this view, and Treasury reports zero verified available funds and zero verified revenue. A verified eligible inquiry would trigger the operator handoff. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.
